content: भोगः [भुज्-घञ्] .²1 Eating, consuming. .²2 Enjoyment, fruition. .²3 Possession. .²4 Utility, advantage. .²5 Ruling, governing, government. .²6 Use, application (as of a deposit). .²7 Suffering, enduring, experiencing. .²8 Feeling, perception. .²9 Enjoyment of women, sexual enjoyment, carnal pleasure. .²10 An enjoyment, an object of enjoyment or pleasure; भोगे रोगभयम् <ls>Bh. 3. 35</ls>; भोगा मेघवितानमध्यविलसत्सौदामिनीचञ्चलाः <ls>Bh. 3. 54</ls>; भोगो विभवभेदश्च निष्कृतिर्मुक्तिरेव च <ls>Brav. P.</ls>; <ls>Bg. 1. 32</ls>. .²11 A repast, feast, banquet. .²12 Food. .²13 Food offered to an idol. .²14 Profit, gain. .²15 Income, revenue. .²16 Wealth; भोगान् भोगानिवाहेयानध्यास्यापन्न दुर्लभा <ls>Ki. 11. 23</ls>. .²17 The wages of prostitutes. .²18 A curve, coil, winding. .²19 The (expanded) hood of a snake; श्वसदसितभुजङ्गभोगाङ्गदग्रन्थि <ab>&c.</ab> <ls>Māl. 5. 23</ls>; <ls>R. 10. 7</ls>, <ls n="R.">11. 59</ls>. .²20 A snake. .²21 The body. .²22 An army in column. .²23 The passing (of an asterism). .²24 The part of the ecliptic occupied by each of the 27 Nakṣatras.
